*[[14th floor case]]
**The [[Thailand|Thai]] [[Department of Corrections (Thailand)|corrections department]] approves the early release of former [[Prime Minister of Thailand|prime minister]] [[Thaksin Shinawatra]], who is serving a one-year prison sentence for [[Corruption in Thailand|corruption]], citing his age and the limited time remaining on his sentence, with his release subject to [[Probation and parole officer#Thailand|probation]] conditions. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260429-thai-ex-pm-thaksin-to-be-released-from-prison-next-month (AFP via France 24)]

**The [[Seoul High Court]] increases former [[South Korea]]n [[President of South Korea|president]] [[Yoon Suk Yeol]]'s sentence to seven years in prison for [[obstruction of justice]] and [[abuse of power]], citing his use of [[Presidential Security Service (South Korea)|presidential security personnel]] to interfere with his arrest and other actions. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260429-south-korean-court-hikes-ex-president-s-sentence-for-obstructing-justice (AFP via France 24)]
